limitations: Overall FAIL is preserved. Two guest QEMU exit0 mean evidence collection/poweroff completed, not cooperative product success.
Startup backlog plus fd proves connection to stopped helper listener, not helper acceptance, FD grant, IMPORT or an in-kernel USB operation.

Host TX payload bytes are not retained as a separate raw artifact; independent review checks the actual runtime sink count/digest/exact-match record and fixed collector source, not a fabricated payload capture.
Historical child identity/sysfs/FD/wchan facts are recorded measurements; no live guest reads were repeated during offline review.
No final backend snapshot exists after main TERM, so pending/budget0 or backend reap/cancel totals cannot be inferred from process/FD disappearance or VHCI NULL.
Post-observation device drivers were None at the 20s bound; this proves the observed restoration failure for these guest devices, not permanent state or arbitrary physical hardware.
Only disposable QEMU HID/FTDI, ordinary application UID1000/root helper and guest-only signals/modules were tested; no host USB/network/module mutation or SIGKILL recovery evidence.
This is dirty development negative evidence, not clean final acceptance. No builds, child tests, QEMU, USB, ptrace or repository writes were performed by this review.
